# Hoenn

[Back to the guide](../players-guide.md#part-2-walkthrough-and-strategy)

Hoenn has 43 Explore areas and a ladder of 8 gyms, 4 Elite Four seats and a champion. Its areas come from Emerald.

How to read the tables: **Chance** is the share of that area's encounters, once the whole story is open. **Level** is what you meet. A Pokemon marked *later in the story* shows up only after more badges. 

## The ladder at a glance

| # | Trainer | Where | Type | Levels | Earns |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Roxanne | Rustboro | Rock | 12-15 | Stone Badge |
| 2 | Brawly | Dewford | Fighting | 16-19 | Knuckle Badge |

#### Gym 1: Roxanne (Rustboro) -- the Stone Badge
Rock specialist. 3 Pokemon, best level 15: your team fights at level 15 at most, and on hard you bring 3 at most. Prize money: $750 on easy, $1,500 on hard (half again for a rematch).

| Pokemon | Type | Level | Moves |
|---|---|---|---|
| Geodude | Rock/Ground | 12 | Bulldoze, Rock Throw, Tackle, Harden |
| Geodude | Rock/Ground | 12 | Bulldoze, Rock Throw, Tackle, Harden |
| Nosepass | Rock | 15 | Rock Throw, Spark, Tackle, Harden |

**Hit them with** Steel, Ground, Fighting moves. **Their attacks are** Normal, Electric, Ground, Rock. **Careful with** Fire, Flying Pokemon: several of those attacks hit them hard. **Catchable before this fight:** Nincada (ROUTE 116).

### The Pokemon League

The four Elite Four seats and the champion are one run: HP comes back for every fight, PP does not, and you cannot put your Pokemon to bed until it ends. See [the League](../players-guide.md#9-gyms-and-the-pokemon-league).

#### Elite Four, seat 1: Sidney
Dark specialist. 5 Pokemon, best level 49: your team fights at level 49 at most, and on hard you bring 5 at most. Prize money: $2,450 on easy, $4,900 on hard (half again for a rematch).
